'''Aramand's''' was an expensive restaurant located in [[Drepplin]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Glova]]. It was the highest class establishment in Drepplin, and it was frequented by the most corrupt individuals in the government, something that allowed anything done within its walls to remain a secret as part of an "old, corrupt politicians" network. Meals at Aramand's were very expensive at 50 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] per person, but were considered definitely worth it. The chefs were all trained as gourmets, familiar with the most exquisite dishes. Aramand's was attached to a [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]], [[the Orchid]], and the whole complex was owned and operated by Glova's [[Governor/Legends|governor]], [[Tegist Byrg]].
